what_changed: Q3 2026 (release, slides and call; 10-Q not filed): revenue $127.6B (+25%), operating income $40.6B (31.8% margin, against the ~34% the set implied), GAAP EPS $2.12 (Zacks pre-print consensus $2.94; $2.67 ex the $0.55 equity-securities loss). Against the old path: Search & other +12% (FY2026 now +14.2% vs +15.9%; AI Mode monetizes lower, Q4 laps the 2025 acceleration), so paid clicks FY2026 112.0 -> 110.33. Cloud $30.7B (+103%) against ~$27.2B on the path, backlog $561B (path for YE2026 577). Cloud conversion 0.42/0.285/0.30 -> 0.4527/0.3289/0.3392 and YE backlog 595.4/693.3 (Cloud $109.9B/$195.8B/$235.0B). Capex Q3 $51.4B, YTD $132.0B; the $195-205B guide was reaffirmed (Q4 would need +32% q/q to reach the midpoint), so FY2026 200 -> 196 (inside, -2%). FY2027 is 'significantly' higher with no number, so the path stays at consensus $301B. Alphabet-level -$7.66B (shared AI R&D): constants -23/-26/-29B -> -26/-31/-34B. Margins: Services 42.5%/44%/45.5%, Cloud 34.5%/36%/38%. FY2026 EBIT ~$165.6B, so Q4 needs ~$44.6B (~31.7%) instead of $48.5B. Shares: 9/30 count 12,486.5M including 36M ATM shares; the $12.4B ATM cash is added, since Q3's ATM was 2.3x RSU tax payments. Research target (12m) $321.16 -> $329.15 (+2.5%): the Cloud path adds ~$24, offset by margins, Alphabet-level costs and Search (~-$16). Stake marks: the release gives only the Q3 loss on equity securities (-$8,664M); the call attributes it primarily to SpaceX's price decline, with marketable equity $90.4B at 9/30. Neither gives a split, so the SpaceX and Anthropic marks are kept from the base round. OPEN ITEM: stake marks from the 10-Q. TPU and OpenAI: TPU systems are now Cloud product revenue and 'a meaningful contributor', but they are not sized (no product financials; 'more to come in through 2027'), and TPU inventory rose to $13.3B. New TPU distribution partnerships with Oracle and Crux AI (Blackstone JV) were announced. No separate TPU backlog was given ('the majority of the backlog related to typical GCP contracts'). The call does not mention OpenAI, so the reported OpenAI deal stays unconfirmed and is not modelled. No post-print consensus was dated after the 10-28 close.
